summary: VistaOne, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of limited partnership units for aggregate consideration of ~$23.6 million, pursuant to its continuous private offering under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and Regulation S. The filing also discloses the transactional net asset value per unit as of April 30, 2026, for multiple unit classes, and describes the existing quarterly unit repurchase program, capped at 5% of aggregate net asset value per quarter. There is no special-situation event; this is a routine periodic disclosure of ongoing capital raises and net asset value.
